ordinary places until they rise for the Lavabo at LM-075A.

does on the way back, on which level they stand at the Epistle side, or which of the two stands

The bow to the cross at Gloria Patri and the return to the centre
“Gloria Patri, et Filio, et Spiritui Sancto” (low)
priest: standing · bow head-moderate · predella-epistle · faces altar-cross · eyes cross ·
AC1: standing · plano-epistle · faces inward-to-priest · eyes inward-to-priest · L at-side / R
AC2: standing · plano-epistle · faces inward-to-priest · eyes inward-to-priest · L
towel @ held by AC1 at the Epistle side [folded]
water-cruet @ held by AC2 at the Epistle side [handle-toward-priest]
lavabo-dish @ held by AC2 at the Epistle side [horizontal]
VARIANT [seasonal] In Passiontide and at Requiem Masses the psalm doxology "Gloria Patri" is
omitted from the Lavabo psalm. The bow that belongs to it and the cue for beginning the return
therefore fall away with it. This is a departure from the baseline, not an alteration of it: the
baseline says the doxology, bows at it, and begins the return at "Sicut erat".
UNRESOLVED: The approved record fixes that the priest bows toward the cross at the doxology but
does not fix the depth of that bow; it is depicted as a moderate bow of the head.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-NAME-01, INV-OBJ-01
